The world's obsession with Ancient Egypt is thousands of years old! Long before Napoleon and the discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb, the Greeks and Romans were already fascinated by Egypt's mighty pyramids, mysterious gods, and powerful pharaohs. Discover how Egyptomania began and why this ancient civilization continues to capture our imagination!
